_comment: Paired env for the otr_8gb_ltx preset (video-tiers). THE RECIPE KNOBS ARE GONE FROM HERE (B6, 2026-07-27): steps / cfg / sampler / T5 device / decode-tiling / negative / VAE-tile geometry are FROZEN IN CODE as eng_ltx_8gb.LTX8_RECIPE_V1 and no longer bind from the environment on a production leg -- a production episode is submitted to an ALREADY-BOOTED server, so a launch-time export cannot decide what it renders with (PBUG-20260723-02). Exporting them here would only earn a per-leg 'ignoring ...' warning. To MEASURE a new recipe, set OTR_LTX_8GB_PREQUALIFICATION=1 in the sweep's own environment and export the knobs there; the resulting clips stamp a '+prequalification' recipe receipt so a measurement artifact is never mistaken for production. What remains below is the render-length CEILING, which is not a recipe knob and still binds -- but READ _ceiling_note BEFORE EXPORTING IT: it is not currently safe to export on its own, so a launcher should CLEAR the full prior-tier key set and export NOTHING from this file until the profile side is pinned to match. The canvas/fps/frame_budget live in the variant widgets. The launcher loads workflows/otr_canonical.json + applies the profile in memory (NEVER this preset as the source workflow). ltx_8gb is flag-free (requires_flag=None).
_ceiling_note: OTR_LTX_8GB_MAX_FRAMES is the ADAPTER's refusal ceiling. The coverage PLANNER reads a different channel -- config/profiles/otr_8gb_ltx.json video.max_render_frames -- which is currently UNPINNED (161). Honouring the 97 below without also pinning the profile would let the planner emit a segment the adapter then refuses mid-episode. See GO_FORWARD open bugs; do not export this alone.
